package.name: g1_courier_fastlio
package.description: Standalone FAST-LIO2 mapping/localization for G1 + Livox Mid-360. Alternatywne podejście do slam_toolbox: LiDAR-Inertial Odometry z Mid-360 + IMU coupling. Output: 3D point cloud map (.pcd) + low-drift /Odometry. Pakiet zawiera launch + config wykalibrowany pod G1 + IMU Mid-360. Wymaga external clone'a Ericsii/FAST_LIO_ROS2 + Livox-SDK/livox_ros_driver2 do src/ — patrz docs/fast_lio_setup.md.
